notes.title: First real update!
notes.notes:
-Added pause menu and moved exit game button to the pause menu
-Replaced exit game button in game with reset to reset 
-Changed wording to be more precise and accurate
-Added mute for in game clicks

notes.title: Trimming the fat
notes.notes: I went through and removed a bunch of built in engine content that wasn't needed for the project that should allow it to be a lot smaller and run a lot faster without a bunch of extraneous oodle shader issues as well.

notes.title: Getting ready for release!
notes.notes: We're int he final stretches for release. I had to update the installation dependencies but otherwise it's looking like we're on track to release around April 11th.
